## Part 1 · 00:00

[00:00] My friendship with Bill and Jan Craig began in 2005 when Bill began mentoring me in debate and eventually asked me to sit on his board, which I did for a few years. At that point, Bill's ministry was known around the world, but it was only a fraction of what it has become today. In fact, I wonder if Bill and Jan even imagined that their ministry would grow to what it is now. I think of the Reasonable Faith website with its abundant resources. I think of its social media presence. I think of high-quality videos on YouTube which they have produced.

[00:41] Countless Reasonable Faith chapters spread across the world. Children's books and even more. William Lane Craig is doubtless one of the most effective apologists in the history of the Christian Church and his wife Jan has been assisting him every step of the way. I think I can say with confidence that we will not see another like him in our lifetime. So, congratulations to the Craigs and Reasonable Faith on its 20th anniversary.
